defects: README still says the 'You win' screen comes after board 3 and 'bot on 3 ends in won' (What I checked), out of date with four boards; CHANGES.md says drive.py 3 now ends lost.
The bridge on board 3 still flings a ball that rides it (ground speed rose to ~4 m/s while the bot pushed left), the m16 defect, unchanged.
roll.py holds only one push at a time, so diagonal pushes cannot be scripted through it.
A plain push right from board 4's start misses the air coin (closest pass 0.67 m from it, pick-up radius 0.5); a run-up is needed.
